prompt: Create a cinematic stylized scene of a friendly-looking monster hiding behind a wall about to scare a kid. The kid is walking by unaware. Make it spooky, polished, readable, and not gory. Do not use text labels unless they help the composition.

scene_plan.title: Friendly Monster Boo
scene_plan.prompt: Create a cinematic stylized scene of a friendly-looking monster hiding behind a wall about to scare a kid. The kid is walking by unaware. Make it spooky, polished, readable, and not gory. Do not use text labels unless they help the composition.

scene_intent.read: clear and immediate understanding of the playful scare moment
scene_intent.cinematic_goal: build tension through composition and lighting, then release with a cute jump-scare

composition.layout: rule_of_thirds with monster in left third, kid walking from right to left along bottom third
composition.silhouette_priority: high - monster's rounded shape and kid's small profile must read instantly
composition.negative_space: open hallway space to the right of kid emphasizes isolation and impending surprise

camera.framing: medium wide shot capturing full bodies and wall corner
camera.angle: slightly low angle to make monster slightly imposing but still friendly
camera.motion: slow dolly left at 0.5 units/sec to increase intimacy as scare approaches

environment.floor: light gray concrete with subtle texture
environment.background: distant hallway receding with soft depth, one doorway visible far right

subjects.pose: crouched behind wall corner, arms slightly raised, head peeking around edge with eyes wide
subjects.color_hint: soft blue fur with lighter belly
subjects.material_notes: fuzzy subsurface scattering material for fur, smooth plastic for eyes and teeth
subjects.animation: idle breathing sway, then sudden forward lunge at beat 3

subjects.pose: walking forward, head down looking at floor, hands at sides
subjects.material_notes: matte fabric for clothes, smooth plastic for skin
subjects.animation: steady walk cycle from right to left across frame

objects.material_notes: same off-white plaster as walls, beveled edges
emissive panel simulating recessed ceiling light

lighting.key: soft blue key light from front-left at 45 degrees, simulating cool hallway lighting
lighting.fill: warm fill from front-right at low intensity to prevent harsh shadows
lighting.rim: subtle rim light from behind to separate subjects from wall

effects.bloom: 0.3 on emissive eyes and doorway light
effects.depth_of_field: focal distance on monster's eyes, f-stop 2.8 for mild background blur

animation_beats.action: kid walks steadily from right to left, monster breathes and shifts weight playfully
monster tenses, eyes widen further, kid continues walking unaware
monster lunges forward with arms up and open mouth 'roar' (cute, cartoonish), kid jumps slightly in surprise
